name: 6-Monoacetylcodeine
summary: 6-Monoacetylcodeine (6-MAC) is an acetate ester of codeine in which the hydroxyl group on the 6 position has been acetylated. It is occasionally present as an impurity in street heroin and is typically created when attempting to create heroin from a solution of morphine in which some of the codeine from the original opium solution still remains.

pharmacology.text: 6-monoacetylcodeine is eventually metabolised into codeine and then into morphine.
